menu:11031000:1.text: You're the mage Charlie sent? Welcome!
menu:11031000:1.source_cn: 你是查理请来的魔法师？欢迎！

menu:11036610:1.text: Meow... this is weird. Something's seriously wrong!

say:2:1623101001:1.text: Strange things... strange things are afoot, Magister!
say:2:1623101001:1.source_cn: 怪事、怪事啊……魔法师大人，出怪事了！

say:3:1623101002:1.text: Catch your breath first, sir. Take your time and explain.
say:3:1623101002:1.source_cn: 先生，你先喘口气，别着急，慢慢说。

say:4:1623101003:1.text: It's downright strange. Our sheep and horses won't touch their feed! Even the cats and dogs freeze up scared... and at night they start wailing like the world's ending!
say:4:1623101003:1.source_cn: 太奇怪了，家里的羊和马都不吃草了！猫猫狗狗也都吓得不敢...

say:5:1623101004:1.text: I checked all around the wheat fields and found nothing. So I'm thinking... maybe this is magic?
say:5:1623101004:1.source_cn: 俺在麦田附近排查了一圈也没发现是怎么回事，所以就想……...

say:6:1623101005:1.text: You know us villagers. We don't know a thing about it. Could you take a look for us?
say:6:1623101005:1.source_cn: 俺们这些村民，你也知道……对魔法一窍不通，能麻烦你们去...

say:7:1623101006:1.text: If it's got the whole animal crowd rattled... we're not dealing with anything ordinary.
say:7:1623101006:1.source_cn: 唔……能让整群动物一起惊慌的，肯定不是普通事情。

say:0:1623102001:0.text: Near the fields... Alright. I'll start there.
say:0:1623102001:0.source_cn: 麦田附近……唔，我先去麦田周围看看吧。
say:0:1623102001:0.male: Near the fields... Alright. I'll start there.
say:0:1623102001:0.female: Near the fields... Alright. I'll start there.

say:0:1623103001:0.text: Maybe the locals noticed something we haven't.
say:0:1623103001:0.source_cn: 或许这里的村民们能发现一些什么。
say:0:1623103001:0.male: Maybe the locals noticed something we haven't.
say:0:1623103001:0.female: Maybe the locals noticed something we haven't.

say:2:1623105001:1.text: They barely move in the daytime. Won't eat, won't sleep. Like they are sick or something.
say:2:1623105001:1.source_cn: 这群动物白天不怎么动，不吃也不睡，生病了一样。
say:2:1623105001:1.male: They barely move in the daytime. Won't eat, won't sleep. Like they are sick or something.
say:2:1623105001:1.female: They barely move in the daytime. Won't eat, won't sleep. Like they are sick or something.

say:3:1623105002:1.text: Yeah... but at night they holler like they've seen a ghost.
say:3:1623105002:1.source_cn: 嗯……但一到晚上就扯着脖子喊，像是被什么东西吓到了。
say:3:1623105002:1.male: Yeah... but at night they holler like they've seen a ghost.
say:3:1623105002:1.female: Yeah... but at night they holler like they've seen a ghost.

say:4:1623105003:1.text: I'm out of ideas. You're a mage, right? Can you talk to animals?
say:4:1623105003:1.source_cn: 我是拿它们没办法了。你是魔法师吧？你会不会和动物说话？
say:4:1623105003:1.male: I'm out of ideas. You're a mage, right? Can you talk to animals?
say:4:1623105003:1.female: I'm out of ideas. You're a mage, right? Can you talk to animals?

say:5:1623105004:1.text: Just ask them what's got them so worked up. This is giving me a splitting headache!
say:5:1623105004:1.source_cn: 要是会的话，干脆就问问它们最近都在闹腾什么。唉，真让我...
say:5:1623105004:1.male: Just ask them what's got them so worked up. This is giving me a splitting headache!
say:5:1623105004:1.female: Just ask them what's got them so worked up. This is giving me a splitting headache!

say:3:1623106001:1.text: Meow, I'm freaking out! They're so scary! What do we do?
say:3:1623106001:1.source_cn: 喵呜，到底该怎么办，那些东西好可怕……该怎么办才好啊！
say:3:1623106001:1.male: Meow, I'm freaking out! They're so scary! What do we do?
say:3:1623106001:1.female: Meow, I'm freaking out! They're so scary! What do we do?

choice_prompt:4:1623106001.text: Meow, I'm freaking out! They're so scary! What do we do?
choice_prompt:4:1623106001.source_cn: 喵呜，到底该怎么办，那些东西好可怕……该怎么办才好啊！
choice_prompt:4:1623106001.male: Meow, I'm freaking out! They're so scary! What do we do?
choice_prompt:4:1623106001.female: Meow, I'm freaking out! They're so scary! What do we do?

say:5:1623106002:1.text: It's... It's... N-No. Don't make me say it. I can't even talk about it without panicking. Ask them!
say:5:1623106002:1.source_cn: 怪事……怪事就是……不！我……我不敢说，我一提就害怕，...
say:5:1623106002:1.male: It's... It's... N-No. Don't make me say it. I can't even talk about it without panicking. Ask them!
say:5:1623106002:1.female: It's... It's... N-No. Don't make me say it. I can't even talk about it without panicking. Ask them!

say:6:1623106003:1.text: It's... something that shouldn't exist! Wicked. Evil!
say:6:1623106003:1.source_cn: 那些东西……是一种不该存在的东西，很邪恶，很可怕。
say:6:1623106003:1.male: It's... something that shouldn't exist! Wicked. Evil!
say:6:1623106003:1.female: It's... something that shouldn't exist! Wicked. Evil!

say:7:1623106004:1.text: Meow! I'll say it! I can't take it anymore! If this keeps up, I'm gonna lose my mind!
say:7:1623106004:1.source_cn: 喵呜，我、我来说！我受不了了，再这样下去我就要疯了！
say:7:1623106004:1.male: Meow! I'll say it! I can't take it anymore! If this keeps up, I'm gonna lose my mind!
say:7:1623106004:1.female: Meow! I'll say it! I can't take it anymore! If this keeps up, I'm gonna lose my mind!

say:8:1623106005:1.text: An evil pumpkin shows up every night! Yes, you heard me. A terrifying looking pumpkin! It rampages all over the place just to scare us!
say:8:1623106005:1.source_cn: 这附近一到夜间，就会出现一种邪恶的南瓜！对，你没听错，...
say:8:1623106005:1.male: An evil pumpkin shows up every night! Yes, you heard me. A terrifying looking pumpkin! It rampages all over the place just to scare us!
say:8:1623106005:1.female: An evil pumpkin shows up every night! Yes, you heard me. A terrifying looking pumpkin! It rampages all over the place just to scare us!

say:9:1623106006:1.text: Please do something! I haven't slept properly in days. I can't live like this!
say:9:1623106006:1.source_cn: 求求你了，快点想办法解决这个麻烦吧。现在我每天晚上都睡...
say:9:1623106006:1.male: Please do something! I haven't slept properly in days. I can't live like this!
say:9:1623106006:1.female: Please do something! I haven't slept properly in days. I can't live like this!

say:0:1623107001:0.text: Sounds like I'll have to investigate after dark.
say:0:1623107001:0.source_cn: 看样子要等到晚上再调查了。
say:0:1623107001:0.male: Sounds like I'll have to investigate after dark.
say:0:1623107001:0.female: Sounds like I'll have to investigate after dark.

say:0:1623108001:0.text: Strange tracks... I'll use transfiguration to follow.
say:0:1623108001:0.source_cn: 这里有怪异的脚印……用变形术追踪试试。
say:0:1623108001:0.male: Strange tracks... I'll use transfiguration to follow.
say:0:1623108001:0.female: Strange tracks... I'll use transfiguration to follow.

say:0:1623110001:0.text: So you're the creepy pumpkin scaring my friends. Party's over!
say:0:1623110001:0.source_cn: 原来是“南瓜先生”吓到了我的朋友，抱歉，这场派对要我来...
say:0:1623110001:0.male: So you're the creepy pumpkin scaring my friends. Party's over!
say:0:1623110001:0.female: So you're the creepy pumpkin scaring my friends. Party's over!

say:0:1623111001:0.text: That should do it. I'd better report back to Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623111001:0.source_cn: 问题应该解决了，得回去告诉赫普老师一声。
say:0:1623111001:0.male: That should do it. I'd better report back to Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623111001:0.female: That should do it. I'd better report back to Professor Hepler.

say:1:1623112001:1.text: Well? Figure out what was causing the trouble?
say:1:1623112001:1.source_cn: 怎么样，找到怪事发生的原因了吗？
say:1:1623112001:1.male: Well? Figure out what was causing the trouble?
say:1:1623112001:1.female: Well? Figure out what was causing the trouble?

choice_prompt:2:1623112001.text: Well? Figure out what was causing the trouble?
choice_prompt:2:1623112001.source_cn: 怎么样，找到怪事发生的原因了吗？
choice_prompt:2:1623112001.male: Well? Figure out what was causing the trouble?
choice_prompt:2:1623112001.female: Well? Figure out what was causing the trouble?

say:3:1623112002:1.text: Good. Glad it's handled. The animals can finally get a good night's sleep again.
say:3:1623112002:1.source_cn: 解决了就好！这下动物们终于能睡个安稳觉了。
say:3:1623112002:1.male: Good. Glad it's handled. The animals can finally get a good night's sleep again.
say:3:1623112002:1.female: Good. Glad it's handled. The animals can finally get a good night's sleep again.

say:4:1623112003:1.text: Thanks for taking care of it.
say:4:1623112003:1.male: Thanks for taking care of it.
say:4:1623112003:1.female: Thanks for taking care of it.
